title: Public site static content
description: Schema for src/data/mock/content-static.json. Edit vars for org-wide values; use {{vars.key}} or {{metadata.pages.*}} placeholders elsewhere. Items with enabled: false are hidden. Team members and events belong in contents-dynamic.json; form fields in form-definitions.json.

imageSrc.description: Internal path (/img/...) or absolute https URL. Fields named image, picture, logo, qrImage, coverImage are normalized at build time.

pagePath.description: Canonical page URL with trailing slash (home is /).

enabledFlag.description: When false, item is hidden. Omitted means shown.

contentVars.description: Global reusable values. Referenced via {{vars.key}} across the file.

paymentGatewayUrl.description: Online checkout URL. Empty string falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL.

contactLocationLink.description: Google Maps embed URL for contact page iframe.

noindex.description: When true, excluded from sitemap and set to noindex.

policies.description: Policy page SEO entries keyed by slug (e.g. privacy-policy).

forms.description: Custom form page SEO entries keyed by slug.

icon.description: Font Awesome brand class (e.g. fab fa-facebook-f).

id.description: Unique nav id. Env override: NAV_{ID_UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES}.

endCta.description: When true, renders as highlighted end button (e.g. Donate).

inMore.description: When true, link appears under the More dropdown.

parent.description: Parent nav link id. Nests the link under that parent, either as a top-level hover dropdown or inside the More menu.

type.description: Form provider/renderer; defaults to 'custom' when omitted.

formId.description: Must match a key in form-definitions.json (native 'custom' forms only).

embedUrl.description: Published embed URL for external ('google'/'microsoft') forms.

embedTitle.description: Accessible iframe title for external forms.

embedHeight.description: Optional CSS height for the external form iframe (e.g. '1200px').

type.description: Form provider/renderer; defaults to 'custom' when omitted.

formId.description: Must match a key in form-definitions.json (native 'custom' forms only).

embedUrl.description: Published embed URL for external ('google'/'microsoft') forms.

embedTitle.description: Accessible iframe title for external forms.

embedHeight.description: Optional CSS height for the external form iframe (e.g. '1200px').

heroStats.description: Labels for hero impact stats; numeric values from GET …/contents/dynamic.

detail.description: Copy for the /projects/{slug}/ detail pages. Every label is optional; omitted ones fall back to a built-in default.

goalsTitle.description: Heading above the project's goals. Defaults to "What We Focus On".

impactTitle.description: Label above the beneficiary count. Falls back to the project's own impactTitle, then "Impact So Far".

eventsTitle.description: Eyebrow for the project's events section. Defaults to "Events".

eventsDescription.description: Supporting copy under the events heading. Omitted means no copy is shown.

eventsEmptyMessage.description: Shown when the project has no events.

backLabel.description: Link back to the projects listing. Defaults to "View All Projects".

bio.description: Default bio fallback for team cards.

policies.description: External policy document links keyed by slug.

forms.description: Custom form page config keyed by slug.
